4659-5003-8123.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Royal Warden, adding {C}{C}.
When Royal Warden dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Royal Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Royal Warden enters, it triggers, creating two tapped artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-5205-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

710-1703-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-4863-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-4863-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Revolutionist without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Revolutionist spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Revolutionist) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-4863-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

2043-5295-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-5295-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1115-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1115-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1115-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-7729.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2292-4484-4668-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2292-4484-4668-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
2292-4484-4668-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-4484-4668-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2921-5170-6132-6559.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

654-681-5412-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
654-681-5412-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4394-4452-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

997-3240-6462-6560.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

856-2921-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer

567-4605-5118-5144.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
567-4605-5118-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Ratchet, causing it to enter the battlefield as Ratchet, Field Medic.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Ratchet, Field Medic token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
The Ratchet, Field Medic token triggers, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Rescue Racer, and return Ratchet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ratchet, Field Medic enters the battlefield, Preston and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ratchet, Field Medic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Ratchet into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Choose not to return Ratchet to the command zone from your graveyard.
The Ratchet, Rescue Racer token triggers, as well as Soul's Attendant.
Resolve the Ratchet, Rescue Racer trigger, causing you to convert it into Ratchet, Field Medic.
Put one of the Ratchet, Field Medic tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 7.

1323-2335-2987.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Channeler Initiate and Barrenton Medic have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
1323-2335-2987.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on Experiment Kraj, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Channeler Initiate's ability by tapping Experiment Kraj and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

243-628-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

1363-1636-3593.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand.
Tradewind Rider do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {R}.
You control at least one additional creature.
1363-1636-3593.description:
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding at least {R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting any creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Riders by tapping it and two other creatures you control, returning a creature card from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

575-2034-4221.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-2034-4221.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Plane.
Repeat.
